# Baseplate

> A small, dependency-light, agent-native Swift toolkit for indie iOS apps. Swift 6.2, iOS 17+/macOS 14+, MIT.
> This is a machine-readable index of the public API; full docs live in each symbol's DocC docstring.
> Repo: https://github.com/lukebradford/swift-baseplate

## BaseplateCore
_Foundation-only, portable: keychain, typed defaults, seeded RNG, humanization, ordering._

### struct CodableDefaultsStore<Value: Codable & Sendable>: @unchecked Sendable
- let key: String
- let schemaVersion: Int
- let maxAge: TimeInterval?
- init( key: String, schemaVersion: Int, maxAge: TimeInterval?
- func save(_ value: Value)
- func load() -> Value?
- func clear()

### struct DailySeed: Sendable
- init( now: @escaping @Sendable () -> Date
- var dayIndex: Int
- func dayIndex(for date: Date) -> Int
- var seed: UInt64
- func isNewDayAvailable(since lastRun: Date) -> Bool

### enum Humanize
- static func relativeDate( _ date: Date, relativeTo reference: Date, locale: Locale
- static func byteCount( _ bytes: Int64, style: ByteCountFormatStyle.Style
- static func duration( _ seconds: TimeInterval, allowed: Set<Duration.UnitsFormatStyle.Unit>
- static func ordinal(_ value: Int, locale: Locale

### enum KeychainAccessibility: Sendable, Equatable

### enum KeychainError: Error, Equatable, Sendable

### struct KeychainItem<Value>: Sendable
- let service: String
- let account: String
- let accessibility: KeychainAccessibility
- func get() throws -> Value?
- func set(_ value: Value) throws
- func delete() throws
- init( service: String, account: String, accessibility: KeychainAccessibility
- static func codable( service: String, account: String, accessibility: KeychainAccessibility

### enum NameOrdering
- static func compare(_ a: String, _ b: String) -> ComparisonResult
- static func areInIncreasingOrder(_ a: String, _ b: String) -> Bool
- static func sortedByName(_ names: some Sequence<String>) -> [String]
- static func sortedByName<Element>( _ elements: some Sequence<Element>, by name: (Element) -> String ) -> [Element]

### struct SeededRandomNumberGenerator: RandomNumberGenerator, Sendable
- private(set) var state: UInt64
- init(seed: UInt64)
- init(state: UInt64)
- mutating func next() -> UInt64

### struct SplitMix64Generator: RandomNumberGenerator, Sendable
- private(set) var state: UInt64
- init(seed: UInt64)
- init(state: UInt64)
- mutating func next() -> UInt64

### struct UserDefault<Value: Sendable>: @unchecked Sendable
- let key: String
- let defaultValue: Value
- var wrappedValue: Value
- var projectedValue: UserDefault<Value>
- init(wrappedValue defaultValue: Value, _ key: String, store: UserDefaults
- init( wrappedValue defaultValue: Value, _ key: String, store: UserDefaults
- func reset()

- var red: Double
- var green: Double
- var blue: Double
- var alpha: Double
- init(red: Double, green: Double, blue: Double, alpha: Double
- init?(hex: String)
- var hexString: String
- var color: Color
- init(resolving color: Color, in environment: EnvironmentValues

- init(preference: HapticsPreference
- var isEnabled: Bool
- func impact(_ style: UIImpactFeedbackGenerator.FeedbackStyle
- func notify(_ type: UINotificationFeedbackGenerator.FeedbackType)
- func selectionChanged()
- func setEnabled(_ enabled: Bool)

### struct HapticsPreference: @unchecked Sendable
- init(defaults: UserDefaults
- var isEnabled: Bool
- func setEnabled(_ enabled: Bool)

### struct ShareSheet: UIViewControllerRepresentable
- let items: [Any]
- var onComplete: (@MainActor (_ activity: String, _ completed: Bool) -> Void)?
- init( items: [Any], onComplete: (@MainActor (_ activity: String, _ completed: Bool) -> Void)?
- func makeUIViewController(context: Context) -> UIActivityViewController

- let id
- let image: UIImage

- var attributionConfigured: Bool
- func url(appStoreID: String, campaignToken: String?
- func url(for app: PortfolioApp) -> URL

- init(apps: [PortfolioApp], onOpen: @escaping (PortfolioApp) -> Void)
- var body: some View

- var systemVersion: String

- var emailSubject: String
- var emailBody: String
- static func current( bundle: Bundle

### struct FirstLaunch: @unchecked Sendable

- var isFirstLaunch: Bool
- func markLaunched()
- func consume() -> Bool

### struct PortfolioApp: Identifiable, Sendable, Hashable
- var name: String
- var tagline: String

- var icon: Icon
- var campaignToken: String?
- var id: String
- init( name: String, tagline: String, appStoreID: String, icon: Icon, campaignToken: String?
- func excludingApp(withID id: String) -> [PortfolioApp]

- let minimumInterval: TimeInterval?

- func recordMeaningfulEvent()

- func markRequested(appVersion: String)
- static func shouldRequest( meaningfulEvents: Int, minimumEvents: Int, firstEventDate: Date?, now: Date, minimumInterval: TimeInterval?, lastRequestedVersion: String?,

### struct ShowOnceFlag: @unchecked Sendable
- let scope: Scope
- let currentVersion: String
- init( key: String, scope: Scope
- var shouldShow: Bool
- func markShown()
- func reset()

### struct VersionChange: @unchecked Sendable
- let currentVersion: String
- init( currentVersion: String, defaults: UserDefaults
- var lastSeenVersion: String?
- var transition: Transition
- func commit()
- static func classify(current: String, lastSeen: String?) -> Transition

- let currentVersion: String

- init( currentVersion: String, showOnFreshInstall: Bool
- var shouldShowWhatsNew: Bool
- func markShown()

## BaseplateStoreKit
_Testable StoreKit 2 entitlements for the no-backend indie._

### struct EntitlementEngine: Sendable, Equatable
- let productIDs: Set<String>
- init(productIDs: Set<String>)
- func evaluate(facts: [TransactionFact], now: Date) -> EntitlementState
- func reconcile( live: [TransactionFact], cached: [TransactionFact], hasPurchaseHistory: Bool, now: Date ) -> [TransactionFact]

### enum EntitlementState: String, Sendable, Equatable, Hashable, Codable
- var isActive: Bool

### class EntitlementStore
- private(set) var facts: [TransactionFact]
- private(set) var products: [Product]
- init( productIDs: Set<String>, defaults: UserDefaults
- var state: EntitlementState
- var hasEntitlement: Bool
- func isEntitled(_ productID: String) -> Bool
- func start() async
- func loadProductInfo() async
- func refresh() async -> EntitlementState
- func restore() async -> EntitlementState
- func observeUpdates()

### enum Grandfather
- static func isGrandfathered( originalAppVersion: String, boughtBefore cutoff: String ) -> Bool

### struct TransactionFact: Sendable, Equatable, Hashable, Codable
- let productID: String
- let isRevoked: Bool
- let expirationDate: Date?
- init(productID: String, isRevoked: Bool
- func isActive(at now: Date) -> Bool
- func isExpired(at now: Date) -> Bool
